facts.text: Jolene mentioned she has been using a bullet journal for time management and found it helpful for tracking tasks and staying organized.

evidence.quote: I've been trying out some time management strategies recently and started using a bullet journal. It's been really helpful for tracking my tasks and staying organized.

facts.text: Jolene shared a photo of her bullet journal with a quote, indicating she finds satisfaction in crossing tasks off her list.

evidence.quote: Not only does it help me stay on top of everything, but it's also so satisfying when I cross tasks off my list. Here's a pic of my newest spread with one of my favorite quotes.

facts.text: Deborah expressed appreciation for the quote Jolene shared and asked if it motivates her when she sees it.

evidence.quote: I love this quote. So uplifting. Does it motivate you when you see it?
